description: Defines the ProjectActivitySearchFilterParams class for filtering project activities in the OrangeHRM Time module, specifying search parameters such as project activity name.

classes.name: ProjectActivitySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object extending FilterParams, used for specifying search filters for project activities, particularly filtering by activity name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params and sets default sort field to 'projectActivity.name'.

methods.name: getProjectActivityName
methods.description: Returns the project activity name filter value.

methods.name: setProjectActivityName
methods.description: Sets the project activity name filter value.
